newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Amsterdam zoo keeps shivering penguins indoors.
newsitem.headline: Amsterdam zoo keeps shivering penguins indoors.

text.p: Amsterdam's zoo kept its penguins indoors on Friday to protect them from the bitter winter cold outside.

Dutch television showed the penguins shivering and huddling together and explained that though they hail from the Antarctic, the birds had acclimatised to the normally temperate Dutch weather and might not survive current sub-zero temperatures.
